name: Monotonic Yang Dimension of Full Cube
proof: The full cube itself is an allowed subfamily and has Yang dimension $n$, so $\mathrm Y^*\geq n$. Conversely every subfamily has effective range at most $n$, and the established effective-range Yang bound gives Yang dimension at most $n$. Thus the maximum is exactly $n$.
references: \cite{yang2018homological}; derived using the established effective-range bound
